donations.name: The future impact of our partnership with GOSH
donations.description: We’ve been proudly raising money for Great Ormond Street Hospital Children’s Charity since 2012. Donations help this vital NHS hospital to provide extraordinary care for patients. This year we celebrate 10 special years with the charity as together, we begin working towards transforming children’s cancer care at GOSH as part of our Force for Good programme. Great Ormond Street Hospital Children’s Charity, registered charity number 1160024.
